title: Seaside Vacation Home Near Town Square & Beach Access Sleeps 8
meta_description: 3BR Seaside vacation home for 8 with two king bedrooms, a spacious front porch, outdoor shower, and easy walkable access to the beach and Town Square.
description_expanded: Beachside Kiss | 3-Bedroom Seaside Beach Home Near Town SquareEscape to Beachside Kiss, a charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath vacation rental in Seaside, Florida, just a 4-minute walk from the beach and steps from Ruskin Park and Seaside Avenue. This inviting coastal home blends classic Seaside charm with comfortable living spaces, a welcoming front porch, and a convenient location near Seaside’s iconic Town Square. Ideal for families, couples, and friends, Beachside Kiss makes it easy to enjoy the beach, explore the walkable streets of Seaside, and experience everything this beloved 30A beach community has to offer.Prime Location Near the Beach, Ruskin Park & Seaside Town SquareStay close to everything that makes Seaside, Florida, a favorite vacation destination. Beachside Kiss is just steps from Ruskin Park and Seaside Avenue and approximately a 4-minute walk to the beach. Stroll or bike through Seaside’s picturesque streets, browse the shops and dining spots around Town Square, enjoy outdoor concerts, or spend your days relaxing along the Gulf Coast. With so much nearby, you can leave the car parked and enjoy the convenience of a truly walkable Seaside vacation.Relax on the Welcoming Front Porch & Enjoy Comfortable Living SpacesStart your morning with coffee on the spacious front porch, featuring brand-new lounge seating and a perfect spot for conversation and people-watching. Inside, the open living area offers a comfortable sofa, three club chairs, and a large flat-screen HD TV, creating a welcoming place to unwind after a day at the beach. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats eight and sits conveniently beside the kitchen, making family meals and evenings together easy.Fully Equipped Kitchen for Easy Vacation MealsThe full kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a large double-door refrigerator with a water dispenser, a four-burner electric cooktop, and breakfast bar seating for two. A quality Emeril Lagasse cookware set adds to the kitchen’s functionality, whether you’re preparing a family dinner, enjoying a casual breakfast, or packing snacks for a day on the beach. With a dedicated dining area nearby, Beachside Kiss offers the comforts of home throughout your Seaside getaway.Flexible Florida Room with Twin Sleeper Sofa & WorkspaceJust off the dining area, the light-filled Florida room provides additional space to relax, read, or work remotely. This versatile room includes a twin sleeper sofa, a dedicated desk and workspace, and a newly added full laundry room. It’s a convenient bonus space for guests who need a quiet place to work or a little extra room to spread out during their stay.Three Bedrooms & Two Bathrooms for Family ComfortBeachside Kiss accommodates a variety of sleeping needs with a king primary suite, a second king bedroom, and a third bedroom with built-in twin bunk beds.King Primary Suite: Located just off the west side of the living room, the recently updated primary bedroom features a king bed, fresh paint, and a ceiling fan. The renovated ensuite bathroom includes dual vanities, new quartz countertops, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Second King Bedroom: The second bedroom offers a king bed, large dresser, ceiling fan, flat-screen TV, and a small closet. A full bathroom nearby features a single marble vanity and a tub-and-shower combination.Twin Bunk Bedroom: The third bedroom features built-in twin bunk beds, making it a great choice for children or guests who enjoy a cozy sleeping space. This bedroom shares access to the hallway bathroom.With two king bedrooms, twin bunks, and a twin sleeper sofa in the Florida room, Beachside Kiss offers flexible accommodations for families and small groups.Experience a Classic Seaside, Florida Beach VacationWhether you’re planning a family beach vacation, a couples’ escape, or a relaxing getaway with friends, Beachside Kiss combines classic coastal character, comfortable interiors, and an exceptional walkable location. Enjoy morning coffee on the front porch, spend your days at the beach, and explore Seaside’s shops, restaurants, parks, and community events—all just a short stroll away.Book Beachside Kiss with Homeowner’s Collection and enjoy the charm, convenience, and coastal lifestyle that make Seaside, Florida, so special.Need More Space? Rent the Guest House, Moonlight HugTraveling with additional guests? Beachside Kiss has a separate guest house, Moonlight Hug, available to rent year-round. This guest house accommodates two guests and offers an excellent option for families or friends who want to vacation together while enjoying a little extra privacy.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. UPDATE: Beachside Kiss is undergoing renovations and improvements Fall 2026; the owner is adding a true laundry room, renovating the primary bathroom, updating the kitchen, putting ceiling fans in the bedrooms, and more interior updates to come! New images March 2027 to come!FEATURES 1,472 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceLocated 352 yards (a 4 minute walk) to private residential beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion; largest private beaches on 30A Peacock Alley linens throughout the home, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towelsAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes available for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued (golf carts are considered vehicles). Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; special circumstances or medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002378
